title: fleetlint sources file
description: Names an organisation's catalogs, the baseline every repository gets and who may sign them. See https://fleetlint.org/organisations/.

catalog.description: The fleetlint catalog version this repository runs with (presets, library and fix templates): a tag or a full commit SHA, and the repository when it is not fleetlint/catalog. One version holds for a run; a sources file may set it for every repository.

version.description: A tag or a full commit SHA of the catalog repository. A commit cannot move; a tag can.

repo.description: The catalog repository (https or ssh). Default: https://github.com/fleetlint/catalog.git

extends.description: The baseline in front of every repository's own extends: names from catalogs, or fleetlint:<preset>.

issuer.description: The OIDC issuer that vouched for the signer, e.g. https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com.

subject_regex.description: The certificate subject as a regular expression.

catalogs.description: org and team/<name> mapped to catalog references.
